{{Quote|Jedi who have multiple limbs, such as the Priapulin Master Skwelli, who carried six lightsabers, are a wonder to behold in the extant recordings in the Jedi Holocrons.|Jedi Battlemaster Skarch Vaunk, ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Skwelli''' was a [[Priapulin]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at some point before [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. He was a skillful [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duelist]], and his abilities were recorded in one of the Order's [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]], which were kept in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Skarch Vaunk]] mentioned him in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', first published in [[990 BBY]].

==Biography==
[[File:Star_Wars_The_Jedi_Path_Vault.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skwelli was mentioned in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''.]]
Skwelli was a [[Priapulin]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at some point before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]<ref name="TJP" /> of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> A proficient [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duelist]], his skills were recorded for documentary purposes in one of the Order's [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and kept on file within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|archives]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TJP" />

Considering Skwelli's prowess with multiple [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] a "wonder," [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Skarch Vaunk]] mentioned him in the chapter "Lightsabers: Their construction and use" that she authored for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'',<ref name="TJP" /> first published in [[990 BBY]].<ref name="TJP-PublishingDate">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/12/endnotes-for-star-wars-jedi-path-part-1.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Jedi Path (part 1 of 4)|quote=Okay, so we've established that this particular copy of the book dates from 115 BBY. But the content inside is [&hellip;] dating from the year 990 BBY.}} &mdash; Since the content of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']] dates to [[990 BBY]], the [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force|eponymous in-universe book]] was first published in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Almost nine [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] later, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thame Cerulian]] annotated the passage mentioning Skwelli in his copy of the book, regarding the Priapulin's abilities as "amazing." When the book passed to Cerulian's apprentice [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], however,<ref name="TJP" /> the future [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="TNEC" /> dismissed Skwelli as "sloppy" and lacking the proper footwork.<ref name="TJP" />

==Powers and abilities==
Skwelli practiced [[Form VI/Legends|Form VI]] of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and was capable of wielding six sabers at once due to his multi-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]] Priapulin physiology. His abilities were praised by several Jedi.<ref name="TJP" />

==Equipment==
Skwelli carried six lightsabers.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Created by [[Daniel Wallace]], Skwelli was mentioned in the [[2010]] reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']].<ref name="TJP" />
